note: Paths are relative to assets/combat-sim/ui/. Consumers check membership and fall back to text.

cell.image: ResSq<MaxLV>_<lv> (MaxLV = ResGridSquares[idx][1]); Blank when not selectable

shapes.rule: ResShape<i> OriginCentered; top-left at (Research[6][4i], Research[6][4i+1]); rotation Research[6][4i+2] degrees about (ox,oy); alpha Research[7][1]/100. Polygons from CustomLists.Research[0] in image pixels.

tabs.rule: tabs t=0..4 show UISkillTabs<returnClasses(classId)[t]> (Blank when absent); tab 5 is the SPECIALS tab (UISkillTabs0). Unselected tabs get BrightnessFilter(-30).

icons.rule: SkillTabSelected = classId >= 1: talent = TalentOrder[t + 15*(classId-1)]. SkillTabSelected <= 0 (specials pages 0..-4): t<14 && t!=10 -> TalentOrder[t - floor(t/10) + 615 + 13*(-tab)], t=10 UISkillIconLEFT, t=14 UISkillIconRIGHT. Locked (SkillLevelsMAX[id] == -1) -> UISkillIconLocke.

slots.rule: icon = UISkillIcon<AttackLoadout[OptionsList[1]][s]>; one row is visible at a time, OptionsList[1] selects the row

tab 0 = EquipOrder_X[0][t]; tab 1 (tools) = EquipOrder_X[1][t]; tab 2 = food. Empty slot placeholder EquipmentTransparent<n>: tab 0 n=t+1 (premium pages 101..108 / 201..208), tools n=9..16, food n=17.

slots.entry: [x, y, shape (0 circle,1 square,2 hexagon,3 sparkle,-1 any), levelReq]
slots.rule: obol icon (items/<key>.png, 72x72 source art) top-left at (x-4, y-4); personal slots locked (ObolLocked<shape+1>) while character level < levelReq; empty = Blank

layout.tiers: Statue<n> normal; StatueG gold (StatueG>=1); StatueO onyx (>=2); StatueZ zenith (>=3); n = index+1

layout.rule: Companions are monster animations (sprite 2 "Monster", animation named CompanionDB[i][0]); frame 0 is idle.
